user.title: Add a computer
user.description: Everything here is on the pairing screen the setup command shows on the computer. Run it again and choose "Show the pairing code" if you need it.

data_description.host: The computer's address on your network, such as 192.168.1.50.
data_description.token: The long code from the pairing screen. It is never sent over your network — it signs each request instead.
data_description.mac: Only needed to wake the computer from off. Leave it empty and it will be filled in from the computer itself.
data_description.name: Leave empty to use the computer's own name.

error.cannot_connect: Nothing answered at that address. Check the computer is awake and the address and port are right.
error.bad_token: That pairing code was refused. Run the setup command on the computer and choose "Show the pairing code".
error.bad_mac: That is not a MAC address. It should look like A1:B2:C3:D4:E5:F6.

abort.already_configured: That computer has already been added.
